# IconVault

> IconVault is a free search index of open-source SVG icons, plus free online tools for developers and designers. Search 421,020 icons from 239 open-source sets in one place, customize them, and download as SVG or PNG. No account is needed for the basics.

## Key facts

- 421,020 free SVG icons, including 33,016 alias names
- 239 icon collections (libraries), 215 categories
- 579 free online tools
- 386 free SVG illustrations, recolourable to any brand colour
- Icons are free for personal and commercial use under their own licences (MIT, ISC, Apache-2.0 are permissive; CC BY sets require attribution)
- One-click SVG and PNG downloads, copy as React/Vue/HTML component, bulk export, SVG sprite generation
- Free on the basics, forever; a paid tier exists for heavier use

## Important pages

- [Home](https://iconvault.site/): one search box for every icon set and tool
- [Browse icons](https://iconvault.site/app): search and filter all 421,020 icons
- [Free SVG icons](https://iconvault.site/free-svg-icons): free SVG icons guide with popular sets, counts and licences
- [React icons](https://iconvault.site/react-icons): free React icons guide, packages and copy-as-component
- [Best Lucide alternatives](https://iconvault.site/best-lucide-alternatives): alternatives to Lucide compared
- [Illustrations](https://iconvault.site/illustrations): 386 free SVG illustrations, recolour and download
- [Categories](https://iconvault.site/categories): 215 icon categories
- [Libraries](https://iconvault.site/libraries): all 239 icon collections
- [Tools](https://iconvault.site/tools): 579 free online tools
- [Blog](https://iconvault.site/blog): guides and comparisons about SVG icons

## Popular icon sets indexed

- [Lucide icons](https://iconvault.site/app?set=lucide): 2,144 icons, ISC licence
- [Tabler Icons](https://iconvault.site/app?set=tabler): 6,462 icons, MIT licence
- [Phosphor](https://iconvault.site/app?set=ph): 9,198 icons, MIT licence
- [Heroicons](https://iconvault.site/app?set=heroicons): 1,297 icons, MIT licence
- [Material Symbols](https://iconvault.site/app?set=material-symbols): 24,569 icons, Apache-2.0 licence
- [Bootstrap Icons](https://iconvault.site/app?set=bi): 2,090 icons, MIT licence

## Popular free tools

- [SVG to JSX converter](https://iconvault.site/tools/svg-to-jsx): convert SVG markup into a clean React component
- [SVG optimizer](https://iconvault.site/tools/svg-optimizer): shrink SVGs by 40-80% before shipping
- [SVG to PNG](https://iconvault.site/tools/svg-to-png): export SVG as high-resolution PNG with transparency
- [SVG sprite generator](https://iconvault.site/tools/svg-sprite-generator): combine SVGs into one symbol sprite sheet
- [SVG to Data URI](https://iconvault.site/tools/svg-to-data-uri): SVGs as CSS-ready data URIs
